research_platforms.name: YouTube trends VN
research_platforms.role: broad category and topic reference only

selection_rules: Learn topic angles and pacing only; never download, screenshot, sample frames or extract audio from creators' videos for a new upload.
Create an independently written script and storyboard; do not restage another creator's distinctive expression shot for shot.
Use owner-shot footage, original animation/screen recordings, or separately verified and licensed stock media.
If photos/footage come from licensed stock, record the original asset URL, author, full license terms and credit obligations; do not claim it was filmed firsthand.
Do not describe ideas as confirmed recent facts without dated primary source verification; sensitive breaking news requires independent corroboration.
Store inspiration and licensed source evidence separately. A source video is never a publication asset merely because it is trending.
Never automatically promote a research idea into the Buffer/TikTok queue.
